d:
Here is My Cage. A "manga-inspired" syndicated strip comic that debuted on King Features Syndicate in May 6th, 2007 with the final strip ending in October 31st, 2010.

The comic strip "was" reruning on Universal Uclick's gocomics.com from November 5th, 2011 until November 5th, 2020.
